content: Machine learning approaches to both readability assessment and text simplification rely on data systematically prepared in the form of corpora. Specifically, for automatic text simplification via machine translation, pairs of standard-language/simplified-language texts aligned at the sentence level (i.e., parallel corpora) are needed.
